text:
- **Conflict:** Headlines report two aid workers killed in a Gaza clinic strike and at least six students killed in an Afghanistan school blast. CBS reports a U.S. action against a ship allegedly attempting to breach a blockade of Iranian ports.

- **Domestic risks:** Severe Thanksgiving weather left hundreds of thousands without power; record high tides threaten coastal areas. Wisconsin reported a third measles death, while a headline reports 12,000 Ebola cases in Congo.

- **Politics and technology:** Democratic attorneys general and voter priorities could shape the next Congress and justice system. Reports also flag scrutiny of Nvidia chip sales and allegedly banned chips at a Chinese data center.
